title: Doc.aspx with a braced sourcedoc GUID and a file parameter: Unresolved, site and file name known (BC-012)

method.text: Recognised a Doc.aspx link. The site and file name can be read from the link, but the document is identified only by its id, so the folder cannot be known without signing in.

identifiers.label: document id (list item unique id) from sourcedoc
